propDocs.Dialog.modal: true blocks the page; trap-focus traps focus only; false allows the page beside the dialog.
propDocs.Dialog.presentation: Dialog, bottom sheet or automatic touch adaptation.
propDocs.Dialog.dismissible: Allow Escape and back gesture dismissal.
propDocs.Dialog.closeOnOutsidePress: Dismiss after an outside press is released.
propDocs.DialogTrigger.disabled: Prevent the trigger opening the dialog.
propDocs.DialogTrigger.focusableWhenDisabled: Keep the disabled trigger keyboard focusable.
propDocs.DialogContent.keepMounted: Keep closed dialog content hidden in the DOM.
propDocs.DialogClose.variant: Default, primary, destructive or corner icon key.
